description: An interface declaration for ContentDao, defining methods for accessing Content entities in a content management system, including retrieval by type, code, language, and store.

classes.name: ContentDao
classes.description: Interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao for Content entity, providing methods to query contents based on various attributes and related parameters.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a list of ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its unique code within a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by its code and store, with an optional language parameter.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered solely by ContentType and store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered solely by ContentType and store (single ContentType).

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType, store, and language, excluding non-visible content.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its identifier and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription based on store and SEO-friendly URL.
